description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetFieldInt, which extends SugarWidgetReportField, providing methods for displaying and filtering integer field widgets in reports within SuiteCRM.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldInt
classes.description: A widget class for handling integer fields in reports, providing methods for display and query filtering.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Returns the list display of the field, delegating to displayListPlain.

methods.name: queryFilterEquals
methods.description: Returns SQL filter for equality comparison based on input.

methods.name: queryFilterNot_Equals
methods.description: Returns SQL filter for inequality comparison based on input.

methods.name: queryFilterGreater
methods.description: Returns SQL filter for greater-than comparison.

methods.name: queryFilterLess
methods.description: Returns SQL filter for less-than comparison.

methods.name: queryFilterBetween
methods.description: Returns SQL filter for between comparison.

methods.name: queryFilterStarts_With
methods.description: Alias for equals filter, used for 'starts with' logic.

methods.name: displayInput
methods.description: Returns HTML input element for the field.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles display logic, potentially adjusting for field precision, then calls parent display.
